newsitem.title: UK: Albert Fisher rises on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Albert Fisher rises on bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Albert Fisher Group Plc jumped on Friday as rumours circulated the market that a bid for the food processing and distribution company was imminent, dealers said.
Albert Fisher shares gained 5-3/4p to 40p in volume of over 2.6 million shares by 0740 GMT.
Dealers said they had seen strong demand for Albert Fisher shares but were unable to name a potential a bidder for the company.
"We've had the whole world and his wife on this morning looking for stock but we have not heard a name for the suitor," said one dealer.
